title: Photosynthesis Climate Adaptation Model
positioning: Flagship research model led and designed by Chilperic Armel Foko Kuate: multiscale mechanistic modeling across biology, environment, heat transfer, hydraulics, optimization, sensitivity analysis and evolutionary adaptation.
browser_scope: Reduced educational and portfolio surrogates only. Full scientific runs require the Python repository.
process_layers: CMA-ES evolutionary trait exploration across climates
outputs_to_show: Pareto front: mesophyll vs bundle-sheath assimilation
trait trajectories and climate comparison panels
reduced Workbench objective landscapes and constraint diagnostics
limitations: Browser models are not calibrated physiological predictions.
The full model is high-dimensional and solver-dependent.
Use Python/CasADi/SALib/CMA workflows for claims about real climates or crops.
